ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 85% high-intensity (white/off-white) central surface area versus 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral margins and linear features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. Black pigmentation borders the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Two prominent, near-vertical linear black streaks are mapped symmetrically on the left and right lobes. Focal dark mottling occurs at the outer lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high bounding-box depth ratio relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; amplitude varies between 5-15 pixels. Notable jagged, high-amplitude indentation on the outer right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory on both lobes, curving upward from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected within the black pigmentation of the distal tips, specifically on the far right and upper left margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) located centrally on both lobes; a short diagonal scratch is visible on the lower left-central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical linear scarring (rake marks) across both lobes; distinct yellow-brown chromatic staining along the central vertical axis near the peduncle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical pair of vertical linear scars appearing as parallel tracks on the left and right fluke lobes.
